title: Winter Readiness Before the First Freeze
caption: Before winter weather arrives, check tire tread and pressure, confirm the battery is healthy, keep washer fluid and a winter emergency kit in the vehicle, and clear snow and ice from every window and light. If a warning appears or handling feels unusual, have the vehicle inspected rather than continuing to drive.
